question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.over_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s ON bb.match_id = s.match_id AND bb.over_id = s.over_id AND bb.ball_id = s.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = s.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON bb.match_id = e.match_id AND bb.over_id = e.over_id AND bb.ball_id = e.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.over_id
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT or_.match_id, or_.over_id
    FROM over_runs or_
    JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON or_.match_id = m.match_id AND or_.total_runs = m.max_runs
),
bowler_runs_per_over AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) as bowler_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored s ON b.match_id = s.match_id AND b.over_id = s.over_id AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    WHERE (b.match_id, b.over_id) IN (SELECT match_id, over_id FROM max_overs)
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.bowler
),
bowler_max_runs AS (
    SELECT bowler, MAX(bowler_runs) as max_runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_runs_per_over
    GROUP BY bowler
),
top_3_bowlers AS (
    SELECT bowler, max_runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_max_runs
    ORDER BY max_runs_conceded DESC, bowler
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT bm.bowler, p.player_name, bm.max_runs_conceded, bpo.match_id, m.match_date, m.venue
FROM bowler_max_runs bm
JOIN top_3_bowlers t3 ON bm.bowler = t3.bowler
JOIN (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, bowler_runs
    FROM bowler_runs_per_over
    WHERE bowler IN (SELECT bowler FROM top_3_bowlers)
    ORDER BY bowler_runs DESC, bowler
) bpo ON bm.bowler = bpo.bowler AND bm.max_runs_conceded = bpo.bowler_runs
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON bpo.match_id = m.match_id
ORDER BY bm.max_runs_conceded DESC, bm.bowler
